query: SELECT c.id, c.slug, c.version, c.name, c.category, c.created_at::text AS "created_at!", c.updated_at::text AS "updated_at!", COUNT(b.id)::bigint AS "bundle_count!", (SELECT v.status FROM verification v JOIN bundles b2 ON b2.id = v.bundle_id WHERE b2.challenge_id = c.id ORDER BY v.checked_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_status, (SELECT v.checked_at::text FROM verification v JOIN bundles b2 ON b2.id = v.bundle_id WHERE b2.challenge_id = c.id ORDER BY v.checked_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_at FROM challenges c LEFT JOIN bundles b ON b.challenge_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.slug, c.version DESC
